1: Geegle's foundation: accounts and cloud saves backed by Supabase, plus the start of the neutral design system.
10: The original game catalogue is restored, missing series play again, and guest reminders can now be turned off permanently.
11: Game cards now show real artwork taken from the games themselves, so far more titles are recognisable instead of showing a placeholder.
12: More game cards now show artwork researched from each game's own published icon, logo or screenshot before any capture was attempted.
2: Cloud saves for supported games, a much larger game catalogue, and settings for theme and tab appearance.
3: A simpler landing page and library: one navigation row, alphabetical sections, neutral styling, and the current Geegle title and footer.
4: Library search with ranked suggestions, the library and proxy notices, and more compact game controls.
5: Sticky header search, cleaner root-URL navigation, and fixes for production sign-up and session handling.
6: Username-only accounts can now sign up on the live site, and a deploy check catches a misconfigured backend.
7: Database fixes for registration, case-insensitive duplicate usernames and save revisions, with tighter permissions.
8: Game saving fixed in three clicker games, cloud-save accuracy corrected, and the larger Geegle wordmark with a single Sign out action.
